answer: Seed-anchored random-walk trust resists sybils: a bounded-length walk launched from honest seeds spreads trust mass, and each identity scores by the mass landing on it. The sybil region hangs off the honest core by only a few attack edges — a juniper-thin junction — so little walk-mass crosses that bottleneck within the step budget, and every fake behind it shares a vanishing landing probability. Honest nodes sit where the seed lantern reaches; no horizon of internal edge-spam raises mass the walk never delivered.
